evidence.assumes: backtested IR 1.46 holds; a 10-name EW book has ~2x the tracking error of the 50-name decile

summary.note: Closed picks are frozen at their 63-trading-day forward return vs ^NSEI (price index) — genuine out-of-sample evidence, unlike any backtest. Each Friday records the top 50 (the validated decile); rank<=10 is reported as a sub-book.

liveVsBacktest.caveat: Weekly cohorts overlap (the same names recur), so the live range understates the real uncertainty.
